name: wikiknit
description: Linting for a Markdown vault an AI agent keeps as memory: the link skill tells the agent how to link the notes it writes and to run `wikiknit check --changed` before committing; a PostToolUse hook adds a note's stale and drift findings when the agent reads it (silent otherwise, never blocks). `wikiknit init` installs the git pre-commit hook that runs `wikiknit check --staged`. Needs the wikiknit CLI on PATH.
